Name: Toggle ring glow
Author: Evgen1310
Description:
A simple mod that lets you toggle ring glow effects on and off. It’s so annoying how the glow destroys the quiet atmosphere outside of caves or combat.

Features a customizable toggle key (default: N).

Souce code: [url=https://github.com/Evgen1310/Toggle-ring-glow]https://github.com/Evgen1310/Toggle-ring-glow[/url]

Downloads.Description: Fix memory leak while using Combined Rings.
